Weather refers to the way the air behaves on a particular day, while climate refers to the way the atmosphere, water, and land interact over a longer period of time.

Weather can vary greatly over a short period of time, which is why we have seasons, while climate is more stable over a longer period of time.

An example of weather would be the way the air is warmed and cooled every day, and the temperatures and weather you experience on any given day. On the other hand, climate refers to changes over time such as how much rain falls in a given season, or the number of snowflakes that fall per year.

A time investment is important. You want to make sure that you don't go into the project without time to do the things that make it fun, engaging, and challenging. It's important that you have a goal to work on, so you don't get bogged down with too much work before getting started. If you aren't sure how much time you can devote to the project, get a friend who you know can do it well to help out.
